text: I think I will be able to change universities!!! I still have to send some documents, but they accepted me. I won't know until August if I am really in. I am excited and a little nervous about it.
Just finished Part 5, Volume 11 of Ascendance of a Bookworm. Might start Volume 12 tonight.

I was ignorant of so many things. I grew up in a place so deeply corrupted, and because of it, I missed out on so much. I wish I could have experienced that era. And yet, I was already alive back then, it simply feels as though I had been living in another world. The sky was below and the earth was above. For a long time, I believed that my reality was the law of the world. That is why I love the internet. It allowed me to discover that there were other worlds, other ways of living, thinking, and seeing things. But today, that corruption has spread. Once again, that world, that reality I find so beautiful, feels far away, surviving only in small places; islands in a polluted ocean. I will use what I have learned. I will protect this place. I will try to heal, and I will make sure that corruption never finds me again.
